title: fix(console): the public form shows each section's served description, and a signed-out pin holds the server-localized headings (objectui#12333)
body:
Fixes #12333
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The server half of this card landed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23497: since 18.0.0-next.3, `GET /api/v1/forms/:slug` serves each named section's `label` and `description` in the `Accept-Language` the browser sends. A signed-out visitor's console holds no app bundle (objectui#12034; the `/i18n` domain refuses anonymous callers per objectstack-ai/objectstack#22432). So on the anonymous path the payload is the only source of translated section text. This PR pins the console half.

- **Heading: no source change needed.** The heading renders `sectionLabel(object, name, served label)`; with no bundle the lookup misses and the served label wins. The new pin's heading leg is green on `main` unchanged.
- **Description: rendered, as served.** `FormPage` dropped `FormSection.description` before render, in every language: `buildSections` did not copy it and nothing drew it, while `ObjectForm` renders the same key on the app path. It is now carried on the section row and drawn under the heading with no client-side lookup. One patch changeset for `@object-ui/console`.
- **New pin, `FormPage.signedOutSectionI18n-12333.test.tsx`.** It renders the route under `I18nProvider` with the console's real `loadLanguage`, signed out through `publishAuthState`, and seeds no bundle. Its legs: no `/i18n` request is made; the zh-CN headings and descriptions render as served; CONTROL, an English payload renders English, so the route invents no translation.
- **objectui#8813's pin header amended.** `FormPage.sectionLabelI18n.test.tsx` seeds the bundle itself, so it covers a visitor who holds one (signed in). The header now says so, says the signed-out path is localized by the server payload, and points to the new pin. Its assertions are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Pre-change, new pin on `main` bf376c5: 2 passed (no-i18n-request, served headings), 2 failed (descriptions, control: received `[ null, null, null ]`).
- Ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob `8b0ffb4` with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - Removing the `description` copy in `buildSections` turns the description and control legs red; the 8813 pin stays green.
  - Pointing the heading's fallback at `sec.name` turns the served-heading leg, the control and 8813's missing-key leg red.
- Every console test file naming FormPage, sectionLabel, buildSections or loadLanguage: 41 files, 412 tests passed on the merged head. Console project: 3 shards, 227 files, 2335 tests passed. Console type-check and the console's eslint: exit 0.
- Live, `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.3 (showcase at `2c9bf9430a`):
  - `curl -H 'Accept-Language: zh-CN' /api/v1/forms/contact-us` serves the section label 介绍一下您自己, with `Vary: Accept-Language`.
  - In an anonymous zh-CN Chromium, `/f/contact-us` shows the heading 介绍一下您自己 and makes no `/i18n` request; en-US shows "Tell us about yourself".
  - The section description was not measured live: no showcase section declares one.

## Acceptance notes

- Help text and placeholder are outside this card (the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094 family, objectstack `domain:spec`). On next.3 the server localizes only a named section's label and description, and a section field entry's `placeholder` / `helpText` is served as authored.
- The public form fetch sends no explicit `Accept-Language`; the browser's own header picks the served language, and it matched the browser locale in both readings.
